skillFull: Flies forward and pounds the ground at regular intervals. Each pound creates Bunpling Jellies, with the final pound creating a Giant Bunpling Jelly. Collect the Giant Bunpling Jelly to reduce Energy drain for a certain amount of time. Level up for more points for Bunpling Jellies and Giant Bunpling Jellies, and for slower Energy drain upon collecting the Giant Bunpling Jelly.
story: Bunny Bun once sold dumplings at an old roadside inn. One fateful day, a band of raiders attacked during White Peach Cookie's meal... only to find themselves on the wrong side of her temper. Thanks to that encounter, Bunny Bun escaped disaster and, from then on, became bound to her side. Now working in the kitchens of the Cult of the Umbral Pact, Bunny Bun cares little whether the dumplings are served to righteous clans or dark ones, as long as it can steam up something sweet for White Peach Cookie. Though untrained in any martial arts, Bunny Bun has an uncanny knack for sensing White Peach Cookie's moods, knowing the very moment she is weary or hungry. Could it be that, without even realizing, Bunny Bun is cultivating a martial art of its own?

costumes.name: Venomwing Butterfly
costumes.info: Follow the sweet aroma, and you might find yourself in the kitchens of the Cult of the Umbral Pact. But beware... Bunny Bun's dumplings are always laced with poison, whether served to the righteous or the wicked. It's no wonder Bunny Bun's name is whispered with the same infamy as White Peach Cookie's. Still, rest assured, those truly cherished are given only the sweetest, safest treats.

costumes.name: Reserved Model Student
costumes.info: Bunny Bun gives off an unapproachable aura as the students hustle and bustle, rushing through the school gates in an attempt to not be late for class. It quickly picks out inappropriate school uniforms, missing name tags, and even the slightest bit of tardiness, blocking all possibilities for negotiation with its black mask. Rather than causing fear in its fellow students, this Pet's unwavering demeanor has made more and more students admire the student council. Under this model student's watch, school remains orderly for yet another day.
